summary.headline: Godrej Agrovet Q1 FY27 consolidated sales rose 10% YoY to INR2,852 crore; Crop Care fell 16.2% on a delayed monsoon, and FY27 PBT guidance of mid-teens is now a double-digit target.
summary.overview: Consolidated sales grew 10% YoY to INR2,852 crore despite a delayed monsoon and geopolitical-driven inflation. Animal Nutrition (revenue +12.6%) and Oil Palm (revenue +28.9%) carried the quarter, while standalone Crop Care revenue fell 16.2% on a dry June and slower kharif sowing. Astec reached EBITDA breakeven versus an INR11 crore loss a year earlier, and Dairy grew revenue 11.4% but margins were squeezed by milk procurement costs and packaging inflation. Management softened the overall FY27 guidance from mid-teens PBT growth to a double-digit target, to be refined by end-Q2.

financial_highlights.change: Segment result +14.4%; segment EBIT margin ~17% vs 19% a year ago
Segment margin contracted on lower volumes
vs EBITDA loss of INR11 crore in Q1 FY26
Value-added share rose from 42% to 49% of sales

financial_highlights.metric: Ashitaka + Takai share of Q1 sales (Crop Care)

segments.name: Animal Nutrition
segments.commentary: Revenue +12.6% with cattle feed volume +15%; total segment volume ~7% as poultry was deliberately degrown. Fish feed grew ~20%+ and is ~7% of the business; cattle feed is ~55-56%. Management guides EBIT per tonne of INR2,050-2,150.

segments.name: Oil Palm
segments.commentary: Revenue +28.9% on higher CPO/PKO realisations and volumes; segment result +14.4%, but margin dipped to ~17% from 19% on a pricing-formula change. FFB volumes were flat YoY against a strong early-monsoon base; OER improved.

segments.name: Crop Care
segments.commentary: Revenue -16.2% on delayed monsoon and cotton herbicide volume loss; margin contracted. Ashitaka (maize herbicide), Takai (paddy insecticide) and Ghassnash (soybean herbicide) scaled up; management expects recovery in H2 with a lower base and better chilli/grape season weather, with a call on the year by end-September.

segments.name: Astec LifeSciences
segments.commentary: EBITDA breakeven vs INR11 crore loss a year ago; revenue moderately lower on product mix. Management now expects FY27 revenue growth of more than 20%, with the Q1 8-9% dip to be recovered; CDMO EBITDA margin intact, CDMO share ~50-52%.

segments.name: Dairy (CDPL)
segments.commentary: Revenue +11.4% with volume +8%; profitability hit by elevated milk procurement prices and packaging inflation linked to the Middle East conflict. Route-to-market restructuring of ~18-20 months is under way with a new CEO.

segments.name: Godrej Foods
segments.commentary: Revenue broadly stable as live bird trading is planned to decline 15-20% a year to near zero over 3-5 years. B2C branded volumes grew ~28% (Yummiez volume +22%) and B2C is ~32% of Godrej Foods; profitability hit by input costs, partly offset by pricing.

segments.name: Asia Godrej (Bangladesh JV, ACI Godrej Agrovet)
segments.commentary: Returned to strong growth with double-digit growth in volumes, revenue and PBT, supported by broad-based volume expansion and operating leverage.

guidance_outlook: FY27 consolidated PBT: prior guidance of mid-teens growth now softened to 'double-digit' growth; exact range to be given by end-Q2 (end-September).

Crop Care: July running ahead of last year's base; overall recovery quantum to be assessed by end-September after cotton herbicide season; H2 supported by normal Oct-Nov season for Gracia and Combine, firm chilli prices, and new products.
Astec: full-year revenue growth now guided at more than 20%; Q1 dip to be made up in coming quarters.
Oil Palm: FFB volume growth of high single digit to early double digit over the next 4-5 years; LRP plantation area ~80,000 ha to ~150,000 ha; margin drop expected to even out over the year.

Capex: INR300-350 crore at business level over 3-4 quarters, reportedly within prior guidance; specialty fats refinery to start around September, integrated palm complex phased over 18-24 months; downstream expected to add ~200 bps to EBITDA margin at scale.
Crop Care EBIT margin: management believes ~26-27% can be held despite a tough year, and new products will carry lower margins than Hitweed.
Dairy: milk procurement prices expected to stay at current levels for 2-3 quarters; packaging inflation expected to ease by August; some impact may persist in Q2.
capex_capacity: Oil Palm: area expansion of ~17,000 ha added last year, with a similar addition planned this year and ahead of internal plans in Q1; expansion into Telangana and Northeast.
Integrated palm oil complex at Kannan: first stage (nursery and CPO mill) rolled out in July; seed garden in 18-24 months; refinery to follow.
Specialty fats refinery to start in late August/early September, with early ramp-up in H2.
Capex guidance INR300-350 crore at business level; new investments are said to meet a 16-18% IRR hurdle.
Godrej Foods: investment in automation at plants and advertising behind Yummiez and Real Good B2C; new products including frozen momos and frozen chicken.
demand_pricing: Animal Nutrition: maize price spikes passed through at roughly 60-70%; premium feed demand strong as high milk prices push farmers to upgrade.
Oil Palm: higher CPO and PKO realisations (realisations up ~18%); a government pricing-formula change mid-quarter weighed on margins.
Crop Care: June rainfall deficit of ~40% delayed sowing; cotton herbicide demand hit; new products (Ashitaka, Takai, Ghassnash) gaining acceptance.
Dairy: packaging costs rose after the Middle East conflict; the industry did not pass on full packaging inflation; ~70% of milk price increases passed through.
Godrej Foods: Yummiez/Real Good B2C volumes up ~28%, value up ~20%; frozen chicken and momos are category-creation bets.
Astec: product mix shift; enterprise margins benefited from low-cost raw material in Q1, now normalising as finished-goods prices ease.
